name: Is a home seller roof inspection different from a general home inspection?

mainEntity.name: Is a home seller roof inspection different from a general home inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a home seller roof inspection is typically more detailed and focused specifically on the roof compared to the roof portion of a general home inspection. While a general home inspection covers all major components of a house, a dedicated roof inspection goes into greater depth, often involving climbing onto the roof for a closer look at materials, flashing, and potential hidden issues. This specialized focus can uncover specific roof problems that a broader inspection might overlook.
acceptedAnswer.description: A home seller roof inspection focuses solely on the roof with greater detail than the roof portion of a general home inspection, offering a more in-depth assessment.
